sloka: स तं दृष्ट्वा परिम्लानं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतम् ।रावणिः पितरं युद्धे दर्शनस्थो ऽब्रवीदिदम् ।। ७.२९.३४ ॥
transliteration: sa taṁ dṛṣṭvā parimlānaṁ prahārairjarjarīkṛtam ।rāvaṇiḥ pitaraṁ yuddhe darśanastho 'bravīdidam ।। 7.29.34 ॥

translations.english: Seeing his father greatly exhausted and shattered by the blows in battle, Indrajit, standing visible, spoke these words to him.
